attchmntText: Vineet Laboratories Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Vineet Laboratories Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 during a board meeting on 12 November 2026. Net sales for the quarter were 1418.30 lakh rupees, compared to 1741.95 lakh rupees in the same period last year. Profit for the quarter was 11.58 lakh rupees, versus a loss of 4.01 lakh rupees previously. For the half year, net sales stood at 2457.62 lakh rupees against 2486.13 lakh rupees. The half year profit was 163.01 lakh rupees, compared to a loss of 53.00 lakh rupees. Basic earnings per share for the quarter was 0.08 rupees. Diluted earnings per share was 0.06 rupees. The board also approved the limited review report by NSVR & Associates LLP. Total assets as at 30 September 2026 were 13815.53 lakh rupees. Paid up equity share capital remains 1920.63 lakh rupees.

voiceSummary: Vineet Laboratories Limited has published a notice for its 10th Annual General Meeting for the financial year 2025-26 in the Financial Express and Nava Telangana newspapers on 11.11.2026. The meeting is scheduled for 20th November 2026. Book closure for the AGM and transfer of shares will remain closed from 24th November 2026 to 25th November 2026. The record date for determining eligibility to vote is November 23, 2026. The notice was signed by Director Kathulla Rajesh Kumar, DIN 05349717, on 10.11.2026. The announcement also contains unrelated bank auction notices from Canara Bank and Bank of India regarding the sale of immovable properties and gold ornaments for debt recovery, which are not part of the company's corporate action.

voiceSummary: Vineet Laboratories Limited has announced the closure of its Register of Members and Share Transfer Books from 24th November 2026 to 30th November 2026. This closure is for the purpose of convening the 10th Annual General Meeting. The meeting is scheduled to be held on Monday, 30th November 2026 at 11.00 A.M. The event will take place through Video Conferencing or Other Audio-Visual Means. The intimation was issued on 07th November 2026. The notice was addressed to BSE Limited and NSE Limited. The document was signed by Kathulla Rajesh Kuma, Whole Time Director, with DIN 05349717.

attchmntText: Vineet Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Annual General Meeting to be held on November 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Vineet Laboratories Limited has dispatched the notice for its 10th Annual General Meeting scheduled for 30th November 2026 at 11.00 A.M. via video conferencing. The meeting will consider ordinary business including the adoption of financial statements for the year ended 31st March 2026 and the re-appointment of director Satyanarayana Raju Bhupathiraju. Resolutions are placed for shareholder approval to appoint M/s SVRL & Co. as statutory auditors for five years. The company seeks approval to ratify remuneration of Rs. 75,000 for cost auditors M/s Mannidi & Associates for 2026-27. Members are asked to consent to the appointment of M/s Aakanksha Dubey & Co. as secretarial auditors for five years. A special resolution is proposed to appoint Rajesh Kumar Kathulla as Whole Time Director for five years with a monthly remuneration of Rs. 4,00,000.
